messages.subject: Creating a map using .shp and .csv
parts:
I have been struggling with a map that I have been trying to produce using library(maptools) and library(ggplot2) in R. I have a shapefile which contains names of 8 Towns in Faisalabad  and a csv file.  I have tried the following commands but the problem is that I can't merge the shspefile with my csv file:


library(ggplot2)
 setwd("C:/Users/Sam/Desktop/sam")
 data<-read.table("C:/Users/Sam/Desktop/sam/sidra.csv",header=TRUE,sep=",")
library(maptools)
FSDMap <- readShapeSpatial("Export_Output.shp")
plot(FSDMap)
str(FSDMap)

Tandianwala_Town <- data.frame(FSDMap@polygons[[1]]@Polygons[[1]]@coords)
colnames(Tandianwala_Town) <- c("Lat", "Long")
Tandianwala_Town$Town <- rep(x="Tandianwala", times=nrow(Tandianwala_Town))

Iqbal_Town $Town <- rep(x="Iqbal", times=nrow(Iqbal_Town )) tand

FSDCoords <-
